Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the '''Banvhar Combine''' was a profitable and peaceable [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation. Many species made up the organization, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]], and [[Near-Human]]s. During [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] attacked the miners, quickly crushing the far less militaristic organization. After their defeat, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] allowed his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to use the miners as target practice.<ref name="SWGG">''[[Star Wars: General Grievous]]''</ref>

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[B'dard Tone]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Flynn Kybo]] and [[Codi Ty]] began to hunt down Grievous, determined to end the threat he posed to the galaxy. The leader of the Combine, [[Stellskard]], heard the rumors of their mission and found Kybo on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bryndar]]. He then brought the three Jedi to [[Banvhar Station]], where the Jedi and the miners combined their resources in order to kill Grievous. They were able to find him in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Belsus/Legends|Belsus]]. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] mission quickly went awry, however, with Tone and Kybo being killed by Grievous in a duel, and the miners being overwhelmed with battle droids. Ty was able to rescue a group of Padawans who were fleeing from Grievous, and the miners fled the moon with the Padawans aboard their ship.<ref name="SWGG" />
